CommonHome.heroSubtext: Connex keeps every company, contact, and deal in one place, so your team always knows the next move.
CommonHome.featuresSubtext: From first hello to signed deal, Connex holds the context your team needs to stay close to clients.
CommonHome.featurePipelinesBody: Build pipelines with the stages your team uses, and see where every deal stands.
CommonHome.featureRecordsBody: Companies, contacts, and the full history of every interaction, linked together.
CommonHome.featureAnalyticsBody: Dashboards and reports that turn daily activity into clear decisions.
CommonHome.featureFollowupBody: Tasks, notes, and a shared calendar keep the next conversation on time.
CommonHome.featureMapBody: A live map of companies, contacts, and the deals that link them together.
CommonHome.workflowHeading: From scattered notes to a system
CommonHome.workflowSubtext: Three steps your team already knows, finally in one connected place.
CommonHome.workflowStep1Body: Add companies and people, or bring in the ones you already work with.
CommonHome.workflowStep2Body: Tag, group, and link records so context is never more than a click away.
CommonHome.workflowStep3Body: Tasks and reminders surface the conversation worth having next.
CommonHome.ctaSubtext: Bring your team onto Connex and keep every relationship moving.
CommonHome.footerTagline: The CRM for teams who close by staying close.
